# What should you bid on a sauna or cold plunge install?

> Free sauna and cold plunge install bid calculator: build and prep hours, crew pay, equipment and materials, electrician subcontract, drive and target margin in; a bid price, distance table, overrun check and break-even installs per month out. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
